working_definition: "C15(+) kn(+) adPNs": anterodorsal-lineage antennal-lobe olfactory projection neurons (131 cells, the largest of the five Table S2 marker subgroups) within Davie et al. 2018 res-2.0 cluster 27, co-expressing C15 and knot (kn), reproducing a Li et al. (2017) SMART-seq2 subcluster. Uniglomerular, projecting via iACT to mushroom body calyx and lateral horn. The report explicitly flags this two-marker combination as a finer transcriptomic split of uncertain anatomical specificity, possibly spanning more than one glomerular PN type given its size.
searches_performed: adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN

best_match.fbbt_term: adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN
best_match.fbbt_definition: An adult antennal lobe projection neuron that is derived from neuroblast ALad1 (FBbt:00067346). All of these neurons have axons that fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract (mALT) and innervate the lateral horn.

justification: No FBbt term is built on the C15/kn combinatorial marker code or cites Li et al. 2017 / Davie et al. 2018 for this subgroup (searched directly - no hits). The report concludes this is a transcriptomic subgroup of uncertain anatomical granularity, noting its comparatively large size (131 cells) may indicate it spans more than one closely related PN type rather than a single glomerular class. The cluster IS-A adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN (FBbt:00007438) but the distinguishing C15+/kn+ combination is not captured by any FBbt term, making this an honest broad match.
recommendation: Broad-match to the adPN lineage term; do not mint a new term given the unconfirmed, possibly-composite anatomical identity of this transcriptomic subgroup. Both flags left false per dataset guidance.
